name: NXP Discrete Neural Processing Units (Kinara Ara240)
notes: Official NXP product overview for Kinara Ara-1 and Ara240 Discrete NPUs following NXP's acquisition of Kinara. Specifies Ara240 delivers up to 40 eTOPS (equivalent TOPS) for GenAI and LLM workloads, available as a 16GB M.2 module and USB module, with Ara SDK software stack. Power consumption and bus width are omitted from this summary listing.
